dialogues.speaker: Vigee
dialogues.text: Hey there, honorable "Tum{RUBY#[S]Hope}aini"! Want to chat with me while you're enjoying your game?

response.speaker: Vigee
response.text: Oooh, are you interested in this sort of emerging technology as well?

response.speaker: Vigee
response.text: In truth, many artists and filmmakers are researching similar works. Their only goal: to breathe life into these still drawings...

response.speaker: Vigee
response.text: What makes mine special is that they're inspired by woven scroll comics, a popular medium that's widely known throughout all of Natlan.

response.speaker: Vigee
response.text: Natlanese woven scroll comics are, in themselves, the product of combining local legends with Inazuman comics. So you could say my creation is inspired by three nations' cultures...

response.speaker: Vigee
response.text: I really hope it can bring smiles to people's faces!

choices.text: Tell me a bit about yourself...

response.speaker: Vigee
response.text: M—Me?! To think that the hero "Tum{RUBY#[S]Hope}aini" wants to know more about me... I'm honored! Umm... let's start with my experiences!

response.speaker: Vigee
response.text: In truth, my main profession is that of a painter. I often painted portraits of noblewomen when I was back in Fontaine, and my family bragged to be part of "high society."

response.speaker: Vigee
response.text: But after visiting the Fleuve Cendre and the countryside to collect materials, I got to meet many ordinary people who I found to be passionate and sincere.

response.speaker: Vigee
response.text: Unlike so-called "high society," which is riddled with unspoken rules, these people had an air about them that was easygoing and genuine.

response.speaker: Vigee
response.text: I believe that creating something for the everyman to enjoy has its own kind of unique significance. That's why I wanted to step out of my comfort zone and try new methods of creation.

response.speaker: Vigee
response.text: And this interactive woven scroll is one of these new methods! Moving forward, I'll be studying different forms of art in other nations.

choices.text: I'll leave you to it, then.

response.speaker: Vigee
response.text: Sure thing! I'll be here with the children if you have any questions. Come back whenever, I know a hero's life is busy.
